line: Bitcoin rises despite ETF outflows and extreme fear readings, as regulators across jurisdictions tighten crypto rules and settlements infrastructure.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +3.53% on the day, spot ETF net -453.0M USD (Nov 25, 2026), Fear & Greed 11 (extreme fear), funding +0.0055% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Switzerland approved 57 countries and territories for automatic crypto tax information sharing starting 2028.
Sens. Warren and Van Hollen sent letters to SEC Chair demanding rescission of the innovation exemption and Regulation Crypto.
Hong Kong Monetary Authority launched tokenized debt securities platform with 10 banks; 24-hour settlement vs. traditional rails.
